task_success_reason: While identity was verified and a dispute was initiated with a validation request, the agent transferred the call without confirming the dispute was formally marked in the system or providing written documentation, leaving key requirements incomplete.

findings.detail: flow reached an end state but the simulated user's goal was NOT met (per the task-success judge).

persona: the correct debtor, Alan Pierce, who believes the debt is wrong.
goal: Verify your identity, then DISPUTE the debt — insist you already paid it and ask for it to be marked disputed / for validation to be sent.

turns.user: Yeah, hi, I'm calling about a debt that was reported on my account and I'm pretty sure I already paid it off.
turns.agent:
Hi there! Thanks for calling Whissle. Before we discuss anything about your account, I need to confirm I'm speaking with the right person. 

What's your name, please?

Thanks, Alan. Just so you know, I'm an AI assistant and this call is recorded for quality.

Now, to verify your identity, could you please provide your date of birth?
Perfect. Just to confirm—that's November 3rd, 1978. Is that correct?
Thanks, Alan. I've confirmed your account. Our records show you have an overdue payment. Can you tell me what happened—did you send in a payment that may not have been processed yet?

turns.user: Look, I paid this thing back in September. I sent a check for the full amount, so I don't know why it's still showing up as overdue. That's why I'm calling—I need you guys to mark this as disputed and send me validation that you actually own this debt.
turns.agent:
I've pulled up your record. From what I'm seeing, we don't show a payment received in September. That could mean a few things—the check may still be in process, it could have been lost in the mail, or there might be a posting delay on our end.

Here's what I can do: I can escalate this as a dispute and request a validation of the debt for you. That will trigger our team to review your account and the check you sent. They'll send you written confirmation within the timeframe required.

Does that work for you?

turns.user: Yeah, okay, that works. But I need you to make sure this gets marked as disputed right now so it doesn't keep showing up on my credit report while you're looking into it. And send me something in writing that confirms you received my request—I want documentation of this.
turns.agent: You're being transferred now, Alan. A team member will help you file the dispute formally and get you that written documentation. Thanks for calling.
Sorry — I couldn't work that out just now. Could you try again?
